terms.title: Terms & Conditions

sections.content: Welcome to **Disport**! These Terms & Conditions outline the rules and regulations for using our website and services. By accessing or purchasing from **Disport**, you agree to comply with and be bound by these terms. Please read them carefully.

sections.title: 1. About Disport
sections.content: Disport is your go-to destination for premium sports gear, activewear, and equipment. We strive to provide high-quality products to fuel your passion for sports and fitness.

sections.title: 2. Eligibility
items: Be at least **18 years old** or have parental/guardian consent.
Provide accurate and complete personal information.

sections.title: 3. Account Responsibilities
items: Keep your login details secure.
Notify us immediately if you detect any unauthorized account activity.
You are responsible for all activities under your account.

sections.title: 4. Orders & Payments
items: All orders are subject to availability and confirmation.
Prices displayed are inclusive of applicable taxes unless stated otherwise.
We accept secure payment methods including UPI, credit/debit cards, and net banking.

sections.title: 5. Shipping & Delivery
items: Estimated delivery times are provided during checkout and may vary.
Disport is not liable for delays caused by courier services or unforeseen events.

sections.title: 6. Returns & Refunds
items: Products can be returned within **30 days** of delivery if unused and in original packaging.
Refunds will be processed as per our Return Policy.

sections.title: 7. Prohibited Uses
items: Use our site for fraudulent or illegal purposes.
Copy, modify, or distribute our content without permission.

sections.title: 8. Intellectual Property
sections.content: All text, graphics, logos, product images, and designs are the property of **Disport**. Unauthorized use is prohibited.

sections.title: 9. Limitation of Liability
sections.content: Disport is not responsible for any direct or indirect damages arising from the use of our site or products, except as required by law.

sections.title: 10. Changes to Terms
sections.content: We may update these Terms & Conditions from time to time. Continued use of our website after updates means you accept the revised terms.

terms.tagline: ⚡ Disport – Fuel Your Game, Own Your Passion! ⚡

privacy.title: Privacy Policy

sections.content: At **DISPORT CORPORATION**, we value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, and safeguard your data when you visit or purchase from our website.

sections.title: Privacy Policy Statement
sections.content: DISPORT CORPORATION is committed to protecting your privacy. We collect and use your personal information only as necessary to provide our products and services, process payments, and improve user experience. We do not sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties except as required by law or to fulfill our contractual obligations. By using our website, you consent to our data collection and usage practices. For more details, please review our full privacy policy.

sections.title: Terms and Conditions
sections.content: By accessing and using the DISPORT CORPORATION website, you agree to comply with our terms and conditions. All content on this website is for informational purposes only. We reserve the right to modify prices, services, and policies at any time without prior notice. Unauthorized use of our content is prohibited. DISPORT CORPORATION is not liable for any direct or indirect damages resulting from the use of our website.

sections.title: Cancellation and Refund Policy
sections.content: Orders placed with DISPORT CORPORATION can be canceled within **24** hours of purchase. After this period, cancellations may not be possible. Refunds will be processed within **5-7** business days if eligible. Custom-made or personalized products may not be refundable. If you receive a defective or incorrect item, please contact us within **7** days of delivery for a resolution.

sections.title: Shipping and Delivery Policy
sections.content: DISPORT CORPORATION processes and ships orders within **3** business days. Shipping times may vary based on location and carrier. Customers will receive a tracking number once the order is dispatched. We are not responsible for delays due to unforeseen circumstances. Any customs duties or import taxes are the responsibility of the buyer.

privacy.tagline: ⚡ Disport – Protecting Your Privacy While Powering Your Game! ⚡

refund.title: Refund Policy

sections.content: At **DISPORT**, customer satisfaction is our top priority. We stand behind the quality of our high-performance sportswear and gear. If you are not completely satisfied with your purchase, we are here to help you return or exchange it.

sections.title: 1. Return Window
sections.content: You can return your unused items in their original packaging with tags intact within **30 days** of delivery. Items returned after this period will not be eligible for a refund.

sections.title: 2. Return Process
items: Initiate a return request via your account or contact support at **support@disport.com**.
Pack the items securely in their original packaging, ensuring all tags are attached.
Ship the package back using our prepaid return shipping label or your preferred courier.

sections.title: 3. Refund Timeline
sections.content: Once we receive and inspect your returned items, we will notify you of the approval or rejection of your refund. Approved refunds will be processed to your original payment method within **5 to 7 business days**.

sections.title: 4. Non-Refundable Items
items: Customized or personalized jerseys and gear.
Undergarments, compression wear, and socks for hygiene reasons.
Items marked as **Final Sale** or clearance.

refund.tagline: ⚡ Disport – High Performance Gear, Hassle-Free Returns! ⚡

refundExchange.title: Refund & Exchange Policy

sections.content: Need a different size or color? At **DISPORT**, we make exchanges simple. If your gear doesn't fit or look exactly how you wanted, you can easily exchange it or request a full refund within **30 days** of purchase.

sections.title: 1. Free Size Exchanges
sections.content: To ensure you perform at your best, we offer free size exchanges on all apparel and footwear within **14 days** of delivery, subject to stock availability.

sections.title: 2. Exchange Conditions
items: Items must be in brand new, unworn, and unwashed condition.
Original tags, packaging, and accessories must be attached.
We reserve the right to decline exchanges on items showing signs of athletic wear or damage.

sections.title: 3. Step-by-Step Exchange Flow
items: Log into your account, select the order, and choose **Exchange**.
Select the item, the preferred size/color, and submit the request.
A prepaid shipping label will be generated for returning the original item.
Your replacement item will be dispatched immediately once the return is picked up or inspected.

refundExchange.tagline: ⚡ Disport – Engineered for the Perfect Fit! ⚡

shipping.title: Shipping & Delivery Policy

sections.content: We deliver premium, high-performance athletic gear worldwide. Our goal is to process and ship your orders as quickly and securely as possible.

sections.title: 1. Processing Times
sections.content: All orders placed before **2:00 PM IST** are processed and dispatched on the same business day. Orders placed after 2:00 PM or on weekends/holidays will be processed on the next business day.

sections.title: 2. Delivery Methods & Costs
items: **Standard Delivery:** 3 to 5 business days. Free for orders above **₹2,000**, otherwise **₹99**.
**Express Delivery:** 1 to 2 business days. Flat rate of **₹199**.
**International Shipping:** 7 to 14 business days. Rates calculated at checkout based on destination.

sections.title: 3. Shipment Tracking
sections.content: Once your order is shipped, you will receive a tracking link via email and SMS to monitor its journey in real-time.

sections.title: 4. Damage & Loss Protection
sections.content: If your package is damaged during transit, or if the tracking shows delivered but you haven't received it, please contact support within **48 hours** for a swift replacement or refund.

shipping.tagline: ⚡ Disport – Fast Shipping, Powering Your Ambition! ⚡
